---
title: "studio_request_failed"
description: "The Studio API answered with an error or something that is not Studio."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** The Studio API answered with an error or something that is not Studio.

**How to fix it:** Check the Studio URL (ACTOR_KIT_STUDIO_URL), your access token and the status in the message.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
